missingClauses.zh-CN: 规则文件里没有切出任何编号条款，TypeSafe 无法判断它。规则条款写成 `1. 正文` 这种编号列表；以「归属」开头的段落里的编号只是报告要求，不参与判断。
missingClauses.en-US: The rule file has no numbered clause TypeSafe can judge. Write clauses as a numbered list like `1. ...`; numbered items inside a section whose heading starts with 「归属」(ownership) are reporting requirements and are not judged.

duplicateJudgmentId.zh-CN: 多条规则的编号都是 {id}，{file} 已改用 {resolved}。同一个文件里的条款编号应当唯一。
duplicateJudgmentId.en-US: Several clauses share the number {id}; {file} uses {resolved} instead. Clause numbers should be unique within one file.

judgmentInstructions.zh-CN:
`diff` 中新增或修改的代码是否违反规则「{rule}」？只判断新增和修改的行，不要判断未改动的代码。
规则原文：{criterion}
judgmentInstructions.en-US:
Does code added or changed in `diff` violate the rule "{rule}"? Judge only added and modified lines, never untouched code.
Rule text: {criterion}

criterionTrue.zh-CN: 新增或修改的代码违反了这条规则：{criterion}
criterionTrue.en-US: Added or modified code violates this rule: {criterion}

criterionFalse.zh-CN: 新增或修改的代码没有违反这条规则，或者这次改动根本没有涉及这条规则约束的写法。
criterionFalse.en-US: No added or modified line violates this rule, or the change does not touch anything the rule governs.

localizeInstructions.zh-CN: `candidate_lines` 里哪一行新增或修改的代码最直接地违反规则「{rule}」？规则含义：{criterion}。如果违规点不落在任何一个候选行上，选 {none}。
localizeInstructions.en-US: Which line in `candidate_lines` most directly violates the rule "{rule}"? Rule meaning: {criterion}. Choose {none} when the violation does not fall on any candidate line.

candidateNone.zh-CN: 以上候选行都不是，或者违规点不落在某一行上
candidateNone.en-US: None of the candidate lines; the violation is not attributable to one line
